value.rationale: This natural full classification over *every* prime-power cyclic ring reveals an unexpected characteristic-three rank fraction one quarter, worse than characteristic two one third, sharply contrasting with p/(p+1) in every characteristic at least five. It gives every identifiable operator coordinate and its exact conditioning for a widely used explicit Gabor seed; the p-adic spectral census is a motivated structural theorem rather than a negative normalization check or an unmotivated finite slice. The known all-window diagonalization and qualitative Alltop noninjectivity are not claimed novel.
